title: Synthesis of a GaN Cage Compound with a Hydrazinetetraide Fragment, [NN]<sup>4−</sup>, Stabilised by Six Gallium Atoms
abstract: AbstractThermolysis of the bicyclic gallium hydrazide [(GaMe2)4(NHNMe)(NHNHMe)2] (1) yielded the unique cage compound [(GaMe)4(GaMe2)4(N2)(NHNMe)4] (2). Compound 2 contains a remarkable hydrazinetetraide moiety, [NN]4−, as the central structural motif which is stabilised by coordination to six gallium atoms.
